insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Restore benefit auto-triggers on partial / complete utilisation of SI. Stay Active wearable-app discount up to 8% on renewal. Lifelong renewal; waiting periods reduce by 1 year on each continuous renewal.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Covered up to SI; no sub-limit on room rent; no geography-based sub-limits.

critical_illness_cover.notes: E-Opinion in respect of a Critical Illness — one opinion per policy year. Emergency Air Ambulance up to Rs.2.5 lakh per hospitalisation (SI ≥ Rs.10L).

restoration_benefit.limit_text: 100% of Basic SI restored automatically on complete or partial utilisation.
restoration_benefit.notes: SI restored only once per policy year; expires if unused. Single claim cannot exceed sum of Basic SI + Multiplier Benefit.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health Checkup: SI 3L not applicable; 5L up to Rs.1500; 10L Rs.2000; 15L Rs.4000; 20L+ Rs.5000 (individual); SI 5L Rs.2500 / 10L Rs.5000 / 15L Rs.8000 / 20L+ Rs.10000 (family floater).

permanent_exclusions: Cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, joint replacement etc. — 2-year waiting
notable_exclusions_summary: Flagship indemnity plan with Restore + Multiplier (2x SI for 2 claim-free years) + Stay Active fitness discount. Modern treatments (robotic, stem cell, oral chemo, immunotherapy) covered. Pregnancy / dental excluded.
